regulations.name: Apex.Payroll
regulations.description: Apex Digital Solutions LLC — Level 2 regulation extending US.Payroll with company-specific benefits: §132(f) commuter transit pre-tax benefit (WT 1250) and WFH equipment stipend (WT 1260). No modification of the base US.Payroll regulation required.

cases.name: Apex.Benefits
cases.description: Apex Digital Solutions LLC company-specific employee benefits. Extends US.Payroll without modifying base regulation.

fields.name: Apex.TransitBenefitMonthly
fields.description: Pre-tax commuter transit benefit per pay period. IRC §132(f): FIT-exempt, FICA-exempt, and SIT-exempt for states that conform (NY, NJ, MA, WA, ...). 2026 IRS limit $315/month. Reduces WT 5050 (FITTaxable) and WT 5051 (FICATaxable) via L1 extensibility slot WT 1250.

fields.name: Apex.WFHStipend
fields.description: Taxable WFH equipment stipend per pay period. Fully taxable — increases gross (WT 1260 adds to GrossWages collector). No federal or state exclusion applies unless covered by an accountable plan (IRC §62(a)(2)(A)) — which this flat stipend is not.

wageTypes.name: PreTransitBenefit
wageTypes.description: Pre-tax commuter transit benefit. IRC §132(f): employer-provided transit passes and vanpool benefits are excluded from FIT, FICA, SIT (for conforming states), and FUTA. 2026 monthly limit $315. Reads Apex.TransitBenefitMonthly via USCalculateTransitBenefit action defined in Apex.WageTypeValueFunction. Reduces FIT and FICA taxable bases via WT 1250 extensibility slot in USComputeFitTaxable / USComputeFicaTaxable. Returns negative value.

wageTypes.name: WFHStipend
wageTypes.description: Taxable WFH equipment stipend. Added to gross pay — increases all taxable wage bases (FIT, FICA, SIT, FUTA). Reads Apex.WFHStipend case field. Returns positive value contributing to GrossWages collector.
